caseNameFull: Roosevelt Steamship Co., Inc. v. Brady, Administratrix
attorneys: Messrs. Raymond Parmer and Vernon Sims Jones for petitioner. Mr. Simone N. Gazan for respondent.

opinions.text: The motion to use the certified record in No. 269 is granted. The petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit is denied.
